entries.gap: With first-order MUR boundaries, an on-chip microstrip stays at an energy plateau (-13 dB to -18 dB) and never reaches the end criterion.
entries.symptom: 'Max. number of timesteps was reached before the end-criteria'; the S-parameters look plausible.
entries.workaround: Use PML_8 on the sides and the top (the default of the openems adapter). The adapter fails a run that does not reach the end criterion.

entries.gap: A thin dielectric (0.4 um passivation) in the z mesh sets the time step of the whole run.
entries.workaround: Snap the interface to a near z line (dielectric_snap_um of the openems adapter, default 2 um).

entries.gap: The PDK openEMS workflow opens the AppCSXCAD viewer and stops on a host without a display; a relative simulation path gives a RuntimeError.
entries.symptom: The run waits for a display, or stops at once.
entries.workaround: Use the openems adapter (no viewer, absolute paths).
